 "contents": "import { useEffect } from \"react\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { collarBle } from \"../services/ble\";\nimport type { ForeignEatingWarning } from \"../types\";\n\nconst LEVEL_CONFIG: Record<\n  number,\n  { title: string; color: string; bgColor: string; borderColor: string }\n> = {\n  1: {\n    title: \"误食预警 · 柔性打断\",\n    color: \"text-yellow-800\",\n    bgColor: \"bg-yellow-50\",\n    borderColor: \"border-yellow-400\",\n  },\n  2: {\n    title: \"误食预警 · 增强打断\",\n    color: \"text-orange-800\",\n    bgColor: \"bg-orange-50\",\n    borderColor: \"border-orange-500\",\n  },\n  3: {\n    title: \"误食高风险警报\",\n    color: \"text-red-900\",\n    bgColor: \"bg-red-50\",\n    borderColor: \"border-red-600\",\n  },\n};\n\nfunction triggerBrowserAlert(level: number) {\n  if (level >= 3 && \"Notification\" in window && Notification.permission === \"granted\") {\n    new Notification(\"宠物误食高风险警报！\", {\n      body: \"请立即查看宠物状态并阻止误食行为\",\n      icon: \"/favicon.ico\",\n      tag: \"foreign-eating-alert\",\n    });\n  }\n  if (level >= 3 && \"vibrate\" in navigator) {\n    navigator.vibrate([300, 100, 300, 100, 300]);\n  }\n}\n\ninterface Props {\n  alert: ForeignEatingWarning;\n  onDismiss: () => void;\n}\n\nexport default function ForeignEatingAlert({ alert, onDismiss }: Props) {\n  const { setDigitalTwinMood, setCurrentActivity } = useStore();\n  const level = alert.intervention_level;\n  const config = LEVEL_CONFIG[level] || LEVEL_CONFIG[3];\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    setDigitalTwinMood(\"anxious\");\n    setCurrentActivity(\"alert\");\n    triggerBrowserAlert(level);\n\n    if (\"Notification\" in window && Notification.permission === \"default\") {\n      Notification.requestPermission();\n    }\n  }, [level, setDigitalTwinMood, setCurrentActivity]);\n\n  const handleRemoteIntervene = async () => {\n    try {\n      await collarBle.sendInterventionCmd(0x04, level, 0, 2000);\n    } catch {\n      // BLE not connected - will show as error state\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDismiss = () => {\n    onDismiss();\n  };\n\n  const duration = alert.event.duration_ms;\n  const confidence = alert.event.confidence;\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm\">\n      <div\n        className={`\n          mx-4 w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border-2 p-5 shadow-2xl\n          animate-slide-up foreign-eat-pulse-border\n          ${config.bgColor} ${config.borderColor}\n          ${level >= 3 ? \"foreign-eat-shake\" : \"\"}\n        `}\n      >\n        {/* Header */}\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mb-4\">\n          <span className=\"text-3xl\">{level >= 3 ? \"\\u26A0\\uFE0F\" : \"\\uD83D\\uDEA8\"}</span>\n          <div>\n            <h2 className={`text-lg font-bold ${config.color}`}>{config.title}</h2>\n            <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">\n              Level {level} · {new Date(alert.event.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString(\"zh-CN\")}\n            </p>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Metrics */}\n        <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-4 text-sm\">\n          <div className=\"bg-white/60 rounded-lg p-2 text-center\">\n            <p className=\"text-[10px] text-gray-500\">置信度</p>\n            <p className=\"text-lg font-bold text-gray-800\">{confidence}%</p>\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"bg-white/60 rounded-lg p-2 text-center\">\n            <p className=\"text-[10px] text-gray-500\">持续时长</p>\n            <p className=\"text-lg font-bold text-gray-800\">{(duration / 1000).toFixed(1)}s</p>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Trigger conditions */}\n        {alert.trigger_conditions.length > 0 && (\n          <div className=\"mb-4\">\n            <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1.5\">触发条件</p>\n            <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-1.5\">\n              {alert.trigger_conditions.map((cond) => (\n                <span\n                  key={cond}\n                  className=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/80 text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 border border-gray-200\"\n                >\n                  <span className=\"w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500\" />\n                  {cond}\n                </span>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        {/* Suggested action */}\n        {alert.suggested_action && (\n          <div className=\"mb-4 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-white/70 border border-gray-200\">\n            <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-500 mb-0.5\">建议操作</p>\n            <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-800\">{alert.suggested_action}</p>\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        {/* Actions */}\n        <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n          <button\n            onClick={handleRemoteIntervene}\n            className=\"flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-600 text-white text-sm font-medium active:bg-red-700 transition-colors\"\n          >\n            远程干预\n          </button>\n          <button\n            onClick={handleDismiss}\n            className=\"flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 text-sm font-medium active:bg-gray-300 transition-colors\"\n          >\n            已处理\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "old_string": "export default function Dashboard() {\n  const {\n    activePetId, batteryLevel, bleConnected, events, setEvents,\n    awayDuration, setAwayDuration, pets,\n    setDigitalTwinMood, setCurrentActivity,\n  } = useStore();\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState<EventStats[]>([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<PetEvent | null>(null);\n  const navigate = useNavigate();",
 "new_string": "export default function Dashboard() {\n  const {\n    activePetId, batteryLevel, bleConnected, events, setEvents, addEvent,\n    awayDuration, setAwayDuration, pets,\n    setDigitalTwinMood, setCurrentActivity,\n    foreignEatingAlert, setForeignEatingAlert,\n  } = useStore();\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState<EventStats[]>([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<PetEvent | null>(null);\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const wsRef = useRef<RealtimeSocket | null>(null);\n\n  const handleWsMessage = useCallback(\n    (raw: string) => {\n      try {\n        const msg = JSON.parse(raw);\n        if (msg.type === \"foreign_eating_warning\") {\n          setForeignEatingAlert(msg as ForeignEatingWarning);\n        }\n        if (msg.type === \"new_event\" && msg.event) {\n          addEvent(msg.event as PetEvent);\n        }\n      } catch {\n        // ignore malformed messages\n      }\n    },\n    [setForeignEatingAlert, addEvent],\n  );\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!activePetId) return;\n    const ws = new RealtimeSocket(activePetId);\n    ws.connect();\n    const unsub = ws.subscribe(handleWsMessage);\n    wsRef.current = ws;\n    return () => {\n      unsub();\n      ws.disconnect();\n      wsRef.current = null;\n    };\n  }, [activePetId, handleWsMessage]);"
}

sqrtf(ay * ay + az * az)) * 57.2958f;\n\n    pitch_history[pitch_idx] = pitch;\n    pitch_idx = (pitch_idx + 1) % FE_PITCH_WINDOW;\n    if (pitch_count < FE_PITCH_WINDOW) pitch_count++;\n}\n\nstatic abs(imu_window[idx].accel_z);\n        sum += mag;\n        sum_sq += mag * mag;\n    }\n\n    int32_t mean = sum / FE_CHEW_VAR_WINDOW;\n    int32_t variance = (sum_sq / FE_CHEW_VAR_WINDOW) - (mean * mean);\n\n    return variance > FE_CHEW_VAR_THRESHOLD;\n}\n\n/* ── Foreign eating: multi-condition fusion ──────────────────────── */\nstatic void evaluate_foreign_eating(void)\n{\n    uint8_t mask = 0;\n    uint8_t count = 0;\n\n    fe_state.imu_pitch_low = check_pitch_low();\n    if (fe_state.imu_pitch_low) {\n        mask |= COND_MASK_PITCH;\n        count++;\n    }\n\n    fe_state.imu_chew_vibration = check_chew_vibration();\n    if (fe_state.imu_chew_vibration) {\n        mask |= COND_MASK_VIBRATION;\n        count++;\n    }\n\n    if (fe_state.audio_chewing) {\n        mask |= COND_MASK_AUDIO;\n        count++;\n    }\n\n    fe_state.condition_count = count;\n    fe_state.condition_mask = mask;\n\n    uint32_t t = now_ms();\n\n    if (count >= FE_MIN_CONDITIONS) {\n        if (fe_state.onset_time_ms == 0) {\n            fe_state.onset_time_ms = t;\n        }\n        fe_state.duration_ms = t - fe_state.onset_time_ms;\n\n        if ((t - fe_last_report_ms) >= FE_REPORT_INTERVAL_MS) {\n            fe_last_report_ms = t;\n\n            uint8_t confidence = 50 + (count - FE_MIN_CONDITIONS) * 20;\n            if (confidence > 100) confidence = 100;\n\n            rule_detection_t det = {\n                .type = BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING,\n                .confidence = confidence,\n                .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(fe_state.duration_ms > 65535 ? 65535 : fe_state.duration_ms),\n                .condition_mask = mask,\n            };\n            decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n        }\n    } else {\n        if (fe_state.onset_time_ms != 0) {\n            ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Foreign eating ended, duration=%lums mask=0x%02X\",\n                     (unsigned long)fe_state.duration_ms, fe_state.condition_mask);\n        }\n        fe_state.onset_time_ms = 0;\n        fe_state.duration_ms = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n/* ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nvoid rule_engine_feed_imu(const imu_sample_t  "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\main\\decision_engine.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Decision engine (Layer 3) - fuses rule and model outputs.\n *\n * For foreign-eating events:\n *   - Maps duration_ms → intervention level (Soft / Enhanced / High)\n *   - Tracks repeat events within a 60-second window; auto-escalates to Level 3\n *   - Writes condition_mask into EventReport.reserved low byte\n *   - Triggers local intervention and queues BLE event report\n *\n * For all other events:\n *   - Applies cooldown to avoid duplicate events\n *   - Queues events for BLE upload\n */\n\n#include \"decision_engine.h\"\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"event_manager.h\"\n#include \"ble_service.h\"\n#include \"esp_log.h\"\n#include \"esp_timer.h\"\n#include <string.h>\n\nstatic const char *TAG = \"decision\";\n\n#define COOLDOWN_MS               10000  /* min interval between same-type events */\n#define CONFIDENCE_MIN            50     /* minimum confidence to emit event */\n\n#define FE_LEVEL1_DURATION_MS     2000\n#define FE_LEVEL2_DURATION_MS     5000\n#define FE_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS       60000\n#define FE_REPEAT_COUNT_FOR_LVL3  2\n\nstatic uint32_t last_event_time[8] = {0};\n\n/* Circular buffer of recent foreign-eating event timestamps */\n#define FE_HISTORY_MAX 8\nstatic uint32_t fe_history[FE_HISTORY_MAX];\nstatic int fe_history_idx = 0;\nstatic int fe_history_count = 0;\n\nstatic uint32_t now_ms(void)\n{\n    return (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000);\n}\n\nstatic intervention_level_t fe_duration_to_level(uint16_t duration_ms)\n{\n    if (duration_ms <= FE_LEVEL1_DURATION_MS)\n        return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT;\n    if (duration_ms <= FE_LEVEL2_DURATION_MS)\n        return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED;\n    return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n}\n\nstatic void fe_history_push(uint32_t ts)\n{\n    fe_history[fe_history_idx] = ts;\n    fe_history_idx = (fe_history_idx + 1) % FE_HISTORY_MAX;\n    if (fe_history_count < FE_HISTORY_MAX) fe_history_count++;\n}\n\nstatic int fe_recent_count(uint32_t now)\n{\n    int count = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < fe_history_count; i++) {\n        if ((now - fe_history[i]) <= FE_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS) {\n            count++;\n        }\n    }\n    return count;\n}\n\nvoid decision_engine_feed_rule(const rule_detection_t *detection)\n{\n    if (detection->confidence < CONFIDENCE_MIN) return;\n\n    uint32_t t = now_ms();\n    uint8_t idx = (uint8_t)detection->type;\n    if (idx < 8 && (t - last_event_time[idx]) < COOLDOWN_MS) return;\n    if (idx < 8) last_event_time[idx] = t;\n\n    intervention_level_t level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT;\n    uint8_t do_intervention = 0;\n\n    if (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) {\n        level = fe_duration_to_level(detection->duration_ms);\n\n        fe_history_push(t);\n        int repeat_count = fe_recent_count(t);\n        if (repeat_count >= FE_REPEAT_COUNT_FOR_LVL3 && level < INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH) {\n            ESP_LOGW(TAG, \"Foreign eating repeat escalation: %d events in window -> Level 3\",\n                     repeat_count);\n            level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n        }\n\n        ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Foreign eating: dur=%dms level=%d mask=0x%02X conf=%d repeats=%d\",\n                 detection->duration_ms, level, detection->condition_mask,\n                 detection->confidence, repeat_count);\n\n        intervention_execute(INTERVENTION_COMBO, level, 0);\n        do_intervention = 1;\n    } else {\n        ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Event: type=%d conf=%d dur=%dms\",\n                 detection->type, detection->confidence, detection->duration_ms);\n    }\n\n    event_report_t report;\n    memset(&report, 0, sizeof(report));\n    report.packet_type = 0x01;\n    report.timestamp = (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000000);\n    report.behavior_type = (uint8_t)detection->type;\n    report.confidence = detection->confidence;\n    report.duration_ms = detection->duration_ms;\n    report.intervention_done = do_intervention;\n    report.intervention_result = INTERVENTION_RESULT_UNKNOWN;\n    report.reserved = detection->condition_mask & 0xFF;\n\n    event_manager_push(&report);\n    ble_send_event_report(&report);\n}\n\nint decision_engine_get_repeat_count(void)\n{\n    return fe_recent_count(now_ms());\n}\n\nesp_err_t decision_engine_init(void)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Decision engine initialized (3-level foreign eating + repeat escalation)\");\n    memset(fe_history, 0, sizeof(fe_history));\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "/**\n * Intervention executor - controls speaker, vibration motor, and RGB LED.\n *\n * Three-level intervention:\n *   Level 1 (Soft):     play owner voice + light vibration 500ms + yellow LED 2s\n *   Level 2 (Enhanced): play voice + strong vibration 1500ms + red LED flash 3s\n *   Level 3 (High):     repeat Level 2 (3s interval, up to 5 times) + red LED solid\n *\n * GPIO assignments (T5AI-CORE pins, currently ESP-IDF stubs):\n *   Vibration motor: GPIO_MOTOR (e.g. P6/GPIO6)\n *   Speaker PWM:     GPIO_SPEAKER (e.g. PWM0/D0)\n *   LED red:         GPIO_LED_RED (e.g. P8)\n *   LED yellow:      GPIO_LED_YELLOW (e.g. P9)\n */\n\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"esp_log.h\"\n#include \"esp_timer.h\"\n#include \"freertos/FreeRTOS.h\"\n#include \"freertos/task.h\"\n\nstatic const char *TAG = \"interv\";\n\n/* Pin assignments - will be replaced with TuyaOpen tkl_gpio when migrating */\n#define GPIO_MOTOR       6\n#define GPIO_SPEAKER     7\n#define GPIO_LED_RED     8\n#define GPIO_LED_YELLOW  9\n\nstatic volatile bool level3_active = false;\nstatic TaskHandle_t level3_task_handle = NULL;\n\n/* ── Hardware stubs ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void motor_set(bool on, bool strong)\n{\n    ESP_LOGD(TAG, \"Motor %s (%s)\", on ? \"ON\" : \"OFF\", strong ? \"strong\" : \"light\");\n    /* TODO: tkl_gpio_write(GPIO_MOTOR, on ? 1 : 0); */\n    /* For strong vibration, use higher duty cycle PWM if available */\n    (void)strong;\n}\n\nstatic void speaker_play(uint8_t slot)\n{\n    ESP_LOGD(TAG, \"Speaker play slot %d\", slot);\n    /* TODO: PWM tone or DAC playback from flash storage */\n}\n\nstatic void speaker_stop(void)\n{\n    ESP_LOGD(TAG, \"Speaker stop\");\n}\n\nstatic void led_set(bool red, bool yellow, bool blink)\n{\n    ESP_LOGD(TAG, \"LED red=%d yellow=%d blink=%d\", red, yellow, blink);\n    /* TODO: tkl_gpio_write for LED pins */\n    (void)blink;\n}\n\nstatic void led_off(void)\n{\n    led_set(false, false, false);\n}\n\n/* ── Single intervention sequence ────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void execute_level1(uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    speaker_play(audio_slot);\n    motor_set(true, false);\n    vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(500));\n    motor_set(false, false);\n\n    led_set(false, true, true);\n    vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(2000));\n    led_off();\n    speaker_stop();\n}\n\nstatic void execute_level2(uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    speaker_play(audio_slot);\n    motor_set(true, true);\n    vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(1500));\n    motor_set(false, false);\n\n    led_set(true, false, true);\n    vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(3000));\n    led_off();\n    speaker_stop();\n}\n\n/* ── Level 3 repeat task ─────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\ntypedef struct {\n    uint8_t audio_slot;\n} level3_params_t;\n\nstatic level3_params_t l3_params;\n\nstatic void level3_repeat_task(void *arg)\n{\n    level3_params_t *p = (level3_params_t *)arg;\n    const int max_repeats = 5;\n    const int interval_ms = 3000;\n\n    led_set(true, false, false);\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < max_repeats && level3_active; i++) {\n        ESP_LOGW(TAG, \"Level 3 repeat %d/%d\", i + 1, max_repeats);\n        execute_level2(p->audio_slot);\n        if (!level3_active) break;\n        vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(interval_ms));\n    }\n\n    led_off();\n    motor_set(false, false);\n    speaker_stop();\n    level3_active = false;\n    level3_task_handle = NULL;\n    vTaskDelete(NULL);\n}\n\n/* ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nesp_err_t intervention_init(void)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Intervention module init\");\n    /* TODO: GPIO config for motor, speaker PWM, LED pins */\n    /* gpio_config_t io_conf = { ... }; */\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n\nesp_err_t intervention_execute(intervention_cmd_type_t cmd_type,\n                                intervention_level_t level,\n                                uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Intervention: cmd=%d level=%d slot=%d\", cmd_type, level, audio_slot);\n\n    if (level3_active) {\n        intervention_stop();\n        vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100));\n    }\n\n    switch (level) {\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT:\n            execute_level1(audio_slot);\n            break;\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED:\n            execute_level2(audio_slot);\n            break;\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH:\n            level3_active = true;\n            l3_params.audio_slot = audio_slot;\n            xTaskCreate(level3_repeat_task, \"intv_l3\", 2048,\n                        &l3_params, 4, &level3_task_handle);\n            break;\n    }\n\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n\nvoid intervention_stop(void)\n{\n    level3_active = false;\n    if (level3_task_handle) {\n        ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Stopping Level 3 repeat sequence\");\n    }\n    motor_set(false, false);\n    speaker_stop();\n    led_off();\n}\n"
}

> 
> UART: UART0(P10/P11), UART1(P0/P1) 调试串口 460800
> 
> BLE: 内置蓝牙
> 
> ADC: 12位，A0-A4（可能用于音频采集）
> 
> TuyaOpen SDK API: tkl_gpio, tal_uart, tal_i2c, tal_system_sleep, PR_DEBUG 等

> 
> MPU6050 关键参数（来自用户提供手册）
> 
> I2C 地址: 0x68
> 
> 陀螺仪满量程: 设为 +/-2000 dps，灵敏度 16.4 LSB/(deg/s)
> 
> 加速度计满量程: 设为 +/-2g（常规）或 +/-16g（啃咬检测），灵敏度 16384 LSB/g 或 2048 LSB/g
> 
> 采样率: 50Hz（SMPLRT_DIV = 1000/50 - 1 = 19）
> 
> DLPF: 带宽设为采样率一半 = 25Hz（DLPF_CFG = 4，对应 20Hz 近似）
> 
> 关键寄存器: PWR_MGMT_1(0x6B), GYRO_CONFIG(0x1B), ACCEL_CONFIG(0x1C), SMPRT_DIV(0x19), CONFIG(0x1A), ACCEL_XOUT_H(0x3B), WHO_AM_I(0x75)
> 
> Pitch 计算: pitch = atan2(accel_x, sqrt(accel_y^2 + accel_z^2)) * 180 / PI
>

> 设计目标（来自 MVP 方案）
> 
> 满足以下 2 个及以上条件即触发：
> 
> 颈部俯角持续低于阈值（IMU pitch < -30 度）
> 
> 高频啃咬震动特征（IMU accel 高频分量）
> 
> 音频识别到连续咀嚼/异物啃咬声（audio chewing_score >= 60）
> 
> 三级干预：
> 
> Level 1 柔性打断：播放主人录音 + 轻震动 0.5~1s
> 
> Level 2 增强打断：再次语音 + 强震动 + App 强提醒
> 
> Level 3 持续高风险：重复提示 + 手机高优先级告警
> 
> 第一部分：固件端 -- 迁移到 TuyaOpen SDK + 核心检测逻辑

> 1.0 TuyaOpen 工程结构迁移

> firmware/

> │   ├── mpu6050_driver.c/h      # MPU6050 I2C 驱动 (基于 TuyaOpen HAL)
> │   ├── audio_driver.c/h        # 音频采集 (ADC/I2S via TuyaOpen)

> │   ├── decision_engine.c/h     # 决策引擎
> │   ├── intervention.c/h        # 干预执行 (GPIO/PWM)
> │   ├── event_manager.c/h       # 事件缓冲
> │   └── ble_service.c/h         # BLE GATT (TuyaOpen BLE)
> └── include/
>     └── pet_collar_config.h     # 引脚定义、阈值常量
> 
> app_default.config 核心配置：
> 
> CONFIG_BOARD_CHOICE_T5AI=y
> CONFIG_BOARD_CHOICE_TUYA_T5AI_CORE=y
> CONFIG_ENABLE_BLUETOOTH=y
> CONFIG_ENABLE_I2C=y
> CONFIG_ENABLE_GPIO=y
> CONFIG_ENABLE_PWM=y

> CONFIG_ENABLE_TIMER=y

> 1.1 MPU6050 驱动 (mpu6050_driver.c)
> 
> 基于涂鸦官方 MPU6050 I2C 示例，使用 TuyaOpen HAL API：
> 
> #include "tal_api.h"
> #include "tkl_i2c.h"  // 或 ty_i2c.h
> 
> #define MPU6050_ADDR           0x68
> #define MPU6050_I2C_PORT       0      // T5AI I2C0: SCL=P20, SDA=P21
> #define MPU6050_SAMPLE_HZ      50
> 
> // 寄存器定义 (来自手册)
> #define REG_PWR_MGMT_1         0x6B
> #define REG_GYRO_CONFIG        0x1B   // FS_SEL=3 -> +/-2000 dps
> #define REG_ACCEL_CONFIG       0x1C   // AFS_SEL=0 -> +/-2g
> #define REG_SMPRT_DIV          0x19   // 采样率分频 = 19 -> 50Hz
> #define REG_CONFIG             0x1A   // DLPF_CFG=4 -> 20Hz
> #define REG_ACCEL_XOUT_H       0x3B   // 读14字节: accel(6) + temp(2) + gyro(6)
> #define REG_WHO_AM_I           0x75
> 
> // 灵敏度常量
> #define ACCEL_SENSITIVITY      16384  // LSB/g (at +/-2g)
> #define GYRO_SENSITIVITY       164    // LSB*10/(dps) (at +/-2000dps)
> 
> 初始化流程（对照 CSDN 手册和涂鸦示例）:
> 
> I2C 初始化 (tkl_i2c_init)
> 
> 复位 MPU6050: 写 0x80 到 PWR_MGMT_1，等待 100ms
> 
> 校验 WHO_AM_I == 0x68
> 
> 唤醒: 写 0x01 到 PWR_MGMT_1（PLL X轴陀螺为时钟源）
> 
> 陀螺仪 +/-2000 dps: 写 3<<3 到 GYRO_CONFIG
> 
> 加速度计 +/-2g: 写 0<<3 到 ACCEL_CONFIG
> 
> 采样率 50Hz: 写 19 到 SMPRT_DIV
> 
> DLPF 20Hz: 写 4 到 CONFIG
> 
> 创建定时器任务 20ms 周期读取数据
> 
> 数据读取: 从 0x3B 连续读 14 字节，拼装为 int16_t accel[3] + int16_t gyro[3]
> 
> 1.2 规则引擎 -- 误食多条件融合 (rule_engine.c)
> 
> typedef struct {
>     bool imu_pitch_low;        // 条件1: 俯角 < -30 度
>     bool imu_chew_vibration;   // 条件2: 高频啃咬震动
>     bool audio_chewing;        // 条件3: 咀嚼音频得分
>     uint32_t onset_time_ms;    // 首次满足条件的时间戳
>     uint32_t duration_ms;      // 实时持续时长
>     uint8_t condition_count;   // 当前满足条件数
>     uint8_t condition_mask;    // bit0:pitch, bit1:vibration, bit2:audio
> } foreign_eat_state_t;
> 
> 条件1 - 低头俯角检测:
> 
> 从 accel 三轴计算: pitch = atan2f(ax, sqrtf(ay*ay + az*az)) * 57.2958f
> 
> 滑动窗口 50 点 (1s @ 50Hz)，判断 pitch 是否持续 < -30 度
> 
> 单位转换: ax_g = raw_ax / 16384.0f
> 
> 条件2 - 啃咬震动检测:
> 
> 在加速度数据上计算短时方差 (10 点窗 = 200ms)
> 
> 方差超过阈值 CHEW_VIBRATION_VAR_THRESHOLD 标记为啃咬震动
> 
> 或计算加速度过零率 (ZCR)，连续高频过零标记为节律性啃咬
> 
> 条件3 - 音频咀嚼:
> 
> 保持现有逻辑: chewing_score >= 60 时标记
> 
> 融合判断 (evaluate_foreign_eating()):
> 
> 每次 IMU/Audio 回调末尾调用
> 
> condition_count >= 2 时开始计时，更新 duration_ms = now - onset_time_ms
> 
> 持续满足时每 500ms 上报一次 rule_detection_t
> 
> 条件全部消失后重置 onset_time_ms
> 
> 1.3 决策引擎 -- 干预分级 (decision_engine.c)
> 
> duration_ms <= 2000: Level 1 柔性
> 
> 2000 < duration_ms <= 5000: Level 2 增强
> 
> duration_ms > 5000: Level 3 持续高风险
> 
> 重复检测: 记录最近 60s 内误食事件次数，>= 2 次自动升级到 Level 3
> 
> EventReport.reserved 低字节写入 condition_mask，供前端解析触发原因
> 
> 1.4 干预执行 (intervention.c) -- TuyaOpen GPIO/PWM
> 
> T5AI-CORE 引脚分配（需在 pet_collar_config.h 中定义）:
> 
> 震动马达: GPIO 输出引脚 (如 P6)，tkl_gpio_write 控制
> 
> 扬声器: PWM 输出引脚 (如 D0/PWM0)，播放预存音频段
> 
> LED: GPIO 或 PWM 引脚 (如 P8 红, P9 黄)
> 
> 三级干预实现:
> 
> Level 1: 播放音频 slot0 + GPIO 轻震动 500ms + LED 黄色闪烁 2s
> Level 2: 播放音频 slot0 + GPIO 强震动 1500ms + LED 红色闪烁 3s
> Level 3: 循环执行 Level2 (间隔 3s, 最多 5 次) + LED 红色常亮
>

> 使用 TuyaOpen 的 BLE API 替代 NimBLE，GATT Profile 定义保持与 protocol/ble_gatt_profile.h 一致。

### 不能直接烧录，原因和下一步建议

**不能直接烧**，因为还有几个关键缺口：

1. **BLE 是空壳** -- 固件端的 `ble_service.c` 只打日志不发数据，设备检测到误食后**无法把事件发给手机**，整个数据链路断的
2. **音频驱动是假数据** -- `audio_driver.c` 特征值永远为 0，三条件融合中「咀嚼音频」这条永远不会触发
3. **前端 props bug** -- Dashboard 传 `event`+`onFeedback`，但 ForeignEatingAlert 组件接收 `alert`+`onDismiss`，运行时会报错
4. **SMS 未接入** -- Level 3 应该发短信，但函数定义了却没人调用

### 建议的执行顺序

| 优先级 | 任务 | 原因 |

| **P0** | 先编译验证 TuyaOpen 工程 | 确认 `firmware/src/` 能在 T5AI-CORE 上构建通过 |

| **P3** | 修复前端 props bug + 接入 SMS | 小改动，保证上层体验完整 |
| **P4** | 音频驱动实现 | 取决于硬件麦克风方案是否确定 |

### 编译过程中修复了 4 个问题

1. **头文件路径断裂** -- `#include "../../protocol/ble_gatt_profile.h"` 在 SDK 目录结构下找不到。将 `ble_gatt_profile.h` 复制到 `firmware/include/`，4 个头文件的 include 路径改为 `"ble_gatt_profile.h"`。

2. **I2C API 不匹配** -- `mpu6050_driver.c` 使用了不存在的 `TUYA_I2C_MSG_T` 消息结构体。T5AI SDK 的真实 API 是 `tkl_i2c_master_send(port, dev_addr, data, size, xfer_pending)` + `tkl_i2c_master_receive(...)`，类型名用 `TUYA_IIC_*`（双 I）而非 `TUYA_I2C_*`。

3. **`event_report_t` 静态断言错误** -- packed 后实际 23 字节，原来写的 20 字节，之前从未被 ARM 编译器验证过。

4. **Windows 环境问题** -- 中文路径 `文档` 导致 T5AI 打包脚本 JSON 解析失败（SDK 移到 `D:\TuyaOpen`）；`create_ug_file` 是 Linux ELF 无法在 Windows 执行（改用 `.py` 版本）。

### 所有修改回写到了本仓库

```4:8:d:\文档\Cursor\pet-collar\firmware\src\rule_engine.h
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include "mpu6050_driver.h"

```

```21:34:d:\文档\Cursor\pet-collar\firmware\src\mpu6050_driver.c
static int mpu_write_reg(uint8_t reg, uint8_t val)
{
    uint8_t buf[2] = { reg, val };
    return tkl_i2c_master_send(MPU6050_I2C_PORT, MPU6050_I2C_ADDR,
                               buf, 2, FALSE);
}

static int mpu_read_reg(uint8_t reg, uint8_t *buf, uint8_t len)
{
    int ret = tkl_i2c_master_send(MPU6050_I2C_PORT, MPU6050_I2C_ADDR,
                                  &reg, 1, TRUE);
    if (ret != OPRT_OK) return ret;
    return tkl_i2c_master_receive(MPU6050_I2C_PORT, MPU6050_I2C_ADDR,
                                  buf, len, FALSE);
}
```

下一步可以用 `tos.py flash` 烧录到 T5AI-CORE 开发板验证 MPU6050 I2C 通信了。

## 原因

前端显示的「（AI 服务）Internal Server Error」来自后端 **HTTP 500**。根因不是豆包接口，而是 **本地 SQLite 里的 `events` 表偏旧**，缺少模型里用到的列（至少包括 `intervention_level`、`condition_mask`）。

在拉取宠物聊天所需的事件列表时，SQLAlchemy 会查询这些列，SQLite 报错：

`no such column: events.intervention_level` → 未捕获的数据库错误 → FastAPI 返回 500 → 前端用 `res.statusText` 得到 **Internal Server Error**。

## 修改说明

已在 `ensure_sqlite_schema` 里为旧库补上这两列（与现有 `users` / `pets` 补丁方式一致），**重启后端**后启动流程会执行 `create_all` + `ensure_sqlite_schema`，自动 `ALTER TABLE`：

```17:22:d:\文档\Cursor\pet-collar\backend\app\core\database.py

        ("users", "avatar_url", "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN avatar_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "phone", "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN phone VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT ''"),
        ("pets", "avatar_url", "ALTER TABLE pets ADD COLUMN avatar_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"),
        ("events", "intervention_level", "ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN intervention_level INTEGER"),
        ("events", "condition_mask", "ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN condition_mask INTEGER"),
    ]
```

 "contents": "import i18n from \"i18next\";\nimport { initReactI18next } from \"react-i18next\";\nimport LanguageDetector from \"i18next-browser-languagedetector\";\nimport zhCN from \"./locales/zh-CN.json\";\nimport en from \"./locales/en.json\";\nimport ja from \"./locales/ja.json\";\nimport ko from \"./locales/ko.json\";\n\nexport function syncHtmlLang(lng: string) {\n  if (typeof document !== \"undefined\") {\n    document.documentElement.lang = lng;\n  }\n}\n\nvoid i18n\n  .use(LanguageDetector)\n  .use(initReactI18next)\n  .init({\n    resources: {\n      \"zh-CN\": { translation: zhCN },\n      en: { translation: en },\n      ja: { translation: ja },\n      ko: { translation: ko },\n    },\n    fallbackLng: \"zh-CN\",\n    supportedLngs: [\"zh-CN\", \"en\", \"ja\", \"ko\"],\n    interpolation: { escapeValue: false },\n    detection: {\n      order: [\"localStorage\", \"navigator\", \"htmlTag\"],\n      caches: [\"localStorage\"],\n    },\n  })\n  .then(() => {\n    syncHtmlLang(i18n.language);\n  });\n\ni18n.on(\"languageChanged\", (lng) => {\n  syncHtmlLang(lng);\n});\n\nexport default i18n;\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\i18n\\index.ts",
 "contents": "import i18n from \"i18next\";\nimport { initReactI18next } from \"react-i18next\";\nimport LanguageDetector from \"i18next-browser-languagedetector\";\nimport zhCN from \"./locales/zh-CN.json\";\nimport en from \"./locales/en.json\";\nimport ja from \"./locales/ja.json\";\nimport ko from \"./locales/ko.json\";\n\nexport function syncHtmlLang(lng: string) {\n  if (typeof document !== \"undefined\") {\n    document.documentElement.lang = lng;\n  }\n}\n\ni18n\n  .use(LanguageDetector)\n  .use(initReactI18next)\n  .init(\n    {\n      resources: {\n        \"zh-CN\": { translation: zhCN },\n        en: { translation: en },\n        ja: { translation: ja },\n        ko: { translation: ko },\n      },\n      fallbackLng: \"zh-CN\",\n      supportedLngs: [\"zh-CN\", \"en\", \"ja\", \"ko\"],\n      interpolation: { escapeValue: false },\n      detection: {\n        order: [\"localStorage\", \"navigator\", \"htmlTag\"],\n        caches: [\"localStorage\"],\n      },\n    },\n    () => {\n      syncHtmlLang(i18n.language);\n    },\n  );\n\ni18n.on(\"languageChanged\", (lng) => {\n  syncHtmlLang(lng);\n});\n\nexport default i18n;\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from \"react\";\nimport { useTranslation } from \"react-i18next\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { RealtimeSocket } from \"../services/websocket\";\nimport EventListItem from \"../components/EventListItem\";\nimport EventDetailModal from \"../components/EventDetailModal\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\nexport default function Events() {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { activePetId, events, setEvents, addEvent } = useStore();\n  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<PetEvent | null>(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const wsRef = useRef<RealtimeSocket | null>(null);\n\n  const handleWsMessage = useCallback(\n    (raw: string) => {\n      try {\n        const msg = JSON.parse(raw);\n        if (msg.type === \"new_event\" && msg.event) {\n          addEvent(msg.event as PetEvent);\n        }\n      } catch {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    },\n    [addEvent],\n  );\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!activePetId) return;\n    const ws = new RealtimeSocket(activePetId);\n    ws.connect();\n    const unsub = ws.subscribe(handleWsMessage);\n    wsRef.current = ws;\n    return () => {\n      unsub();\n      ws.disconnect();\n      wsRef.current = null;\n    };\n  }, [activePetId, handleWsMessage]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!activePetId) return;\n    setLoading(true);\n    (api.listEvents(activePetId) as Promise<PetEvent[]>)\n      .then(setEvents)\n      .catch(() => {})\n      .finally(() => setLoading(false));\n  }, [activePetId, setEvents]);\n\n  const handleFeedback = async (eventId: number, feedback: string) => {\n    await api.feedbackEvent(eventId, feedback);\n    setEvents(events.map((e) => (e.id === eventId ? { ...e, user_feedback: feedback } : e)));\n    setSelected(null);\n  };\n\n  if (!activePetId) {\n    return <div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 p-6\">{t(\"common.addPetShort\")}</div>;\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 p-4 pb-24\">\n      <h1 className=\"text-xl font-bold mb-4\">{t(\"events.title\")}</h1>\n\n      {loading ? (\n        <div className=\"text-center text-gray-400 py-12\">{t(\"events.loading\")}</div>\n      ) : events.length === 0 ? (\n        <div className=\"text-center text-gray-400 py-12\">{t(\"events.empty\")}</div>\n      ) : (\n        <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n          {events.map((evt) => (\n            <EventListItem key={evt.id} event={evt} onClick={setSelected} />\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {selected && (\n        <EventDetailModal\n          event={selected}\n          onClose={() => setSelected(null)}\n          onFeedback={handleFeedback}\n        />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}
```

\"\"} {c}\n                </span>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        {isForeignEating && event.suggested_action && (\n          <div className=\"rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 p-3 text-sm text-amber-800\">\n            {event.suggested_action}\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        <div>\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2\">{t(\"eventDetail.yourFeedback\")}</p>\n          <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n            {[\n              { key: \"false_alarm\", label: t(\"eventDetail.falseAlarm\") },\n              { key: \"helpful\", label: t(\"eventDetail.helpful\") },\n              { key: \"visited_vet\", label: t(\"eventDetail.visitedVet\") },\n            ].map(({ key, label }) => (\n              <button\n                key={key}\n                onClick={() => onFeedback(event.id, key)}\n                className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium border transition-colors ${\n                  event.user_feedback === key\n                    ? \"bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600\"\n                    : \"bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-100\"\n                }`}\n              >\n                {label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <button\n          onClick={onClose}\n          className=\"w-full py-3 text-gray-500 text-sm\"\n        >\n          {t(\"eventDetail.close\")}\n        </button>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useTranslation } from \"react-i18next\";\nimport { behaviorLabel } from \"../i18n/helpers\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\nfunction riskColor(type: string, confidence: number): string {\n  if ([\"foreign_eating\"].includes(type) && confidence > 60) return \"border-l-red-500\";\n  if (confidence > 70) return \"border-l-yellow-500\";\n  return \"border-l-gray-300\";\n}\n\ninterface EventListItemProps {\n  event: PetEvent;\n  onClick?: (event: PetEvent) => void;\n}\n\nexport default function EventListItem({ event, onClick }: EventListItemProps) {\n  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();\n  return (\n    <button\n      onClick={() => onClick?.(event)}\n      className={`w-full text-left bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border-l-4 ${riskColor(event.behavior_type, event.confidence)} border border-gray-100`}\n    >\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n        <span className=\"font-medium\">\n          {behaviorLabel(t, event.behavior_type)}\n        </span>\n        <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n          {new Date(event.timestamp).toLocaleString(i18n.language)}\n        </span>\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500\">\n        <span>{t(\"eventList.confidence\", { n: event.confidence })}</span>\n        <span>{t(\"eventList.duration\", { s: (event.duration_ms / 1000).toFixed(1) })}</span>\n        {event.intervention_done && <span className=\"text-indigo-600\">{t(\"eventList.intervened\")}</span>}\n        {event.user_feedback && <span className=\"text-green-600\">{t(\"eventList.feedbackDone\")}</span>}\n      </div>\n    </button>\n  );\n}\n"
}

{conditions.map((c) => (\n                  <span\n                    key={c}\n                    className=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-red-50 text-red-700 text-xs </p>\n          )}\n\n          <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n            <button\n              onClick={() => handleRemoteIntervene(level)}\n              className=\"flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-lg     <button\n              onClick={() => handleRemoteIntervene(3)}\n              className=\"flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-orange-500 text-white text-sm font-medium active:bg-orange-600 className=\"animate-bounce\" style={{ animationDelay: \"0.2s\" }}>·</span>\n              </span>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      <div className=\"px-3 py-1.5 flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto border-t border-gray-50\">\n        {QUICK_KEYS.map((k) => (\n          <button\n            key={k}\n            type=\"button\"\n            onClick={() => sendMessage(t(`miniChat.${k}`))}\n            className=\"whitespace-nowrap px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-full text-[11px] text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 active:scale-95 transition-transform flex-shrink-0\"\n          >\n            {t(`miniChat.${k}`)}\n          </button>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n\n      <form\n        onSubmit={handleSubmit}\n        className=\"flex gap-2 px-3 py-2 border-t border-gray-100\"\n      >\n        <input\n          type=\"text\"\n          value={input}\n          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}\n          placeholder={t(\"miniChat.placeholder\", { name: petName })}\n          className=\"flex-1 bg-gray-50 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-200\"\n          disabled={sending}\n        />\n        <button\n          type=\"submit\"\n          disabled={!input.trim() || sending}\n          className=\"w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs disabled:opacity-40 active:scale-95 transition-transform\"\n        >\n          ↑\n        </button>\n      </form>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

from \"../types\";\n\ninterface VAction {\n  id: string;\n  icon: string;\n  color: string;\n  pose: PetPose;\n  particles: string[];\n  cooldownMs: number;\n}\n\nconst ACTION_DEFS: VAction[] = [\n  { particles: [\"✨\", \"💫\", \"🪮\"], cooldownMs: 8000 },\n  { id: \"bath\", icon: \"🛁\", color: \"bg-blue-50 text-blue-600\", pose: \"bathing\", particles: [\"🛁\", \"🫧\", \"💦\"], cooldownMs: 12000 },\n ACTION_DEFS.map((a) => ({ ...a, label: t(`virtual.${a.id}`) })),\n    [t],\n  );\n\n  const now = Date.now();\n\n  const handleAction = useCallback((action: VAction & { label: string }) => {\n    const remaining = (cooldowns[action.id] ?? 0) - Date.now();\n    if (remaining > 0) return;\n\n    setOverridePose(action.pose);\n    bumpIntimacy(3);\n    setLastInteraction({ type: action.id, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n    addMoodRecord({ mood: \"happy\", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n\n    setCooldowns((prev) => ({ ...prev, [action.id]: Date.now() + action.cooldownMs }));\n\n    const bubbleKey = POSE_BUBBLE[action.pose];\n    setFeedbackText(bubbleKey ? t(`virtual.${bubbleKey}`) : null);\n    setTimeout(() => setFeedbackText(null), 2500);\n\n    const particles = action.particles.flatMap((emoji, i) =>\n      Array.from({ length: 2 }, (_, j) => ({ id: Date.now() + i * 10 + j, emoji }))\n    );\n    setActiveParticles(particles);\n    setTimeout(() => setActiveParticles([]), 1500);\n\n    setTimeout(() => setOverridePose(null), 3000);\n  }, [cooldowns, setOverridePose, bumpIntimacy, setLastInteraction, addMoodRecord, t]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-3\">\n        <p className=\"text-sm font-medium <div className=\"relative\">\n        <div className=\"grid grid-cols-4 gap-2\">\n          {actions.map((action) => {\n            const cdEnd = cooldowns[action.id] ?? 0;\n            const onCooldown = now < cdEnd;\n\n            return (\n              <button\n                key={action.id}\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => handleAction(action)}\n                disabled={onCooldown}\n                className={`flex flex-col items-center gap-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl active:scale-95 transition-all ${\n                  onCooldown ? \"opacity-40 transition-transform ${\n                  !onCooldown ? \"hover:scale-110\" : \"\"\n                }`}>\n                  {action.icon}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"particle-float absolute text-xl\"\n                style={{\n                  left: `${20 + Math.random() * 60}%`,\n                  top: `${Math.random() * 60}%`,\n                }}\n              >\n                {p.emoji}\n              </span>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

 "contents": "import { useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport { useTranslation } from \"react-i18next\";\nimport { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip } from \"recharts\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport ScoreRing from \"./ScoreRing\";\nimport type { DigitalTwinMood } from \"../types\";\n\nconst MOOD_SCORE: Record<DigitalTwinMood, number> = {\n  happy: 5,\n  calm: 4,\n  bored: 3,\n  anxious: 2,\n  sleepy: 1,\n};\n\nexport default function MoodPanel() {\n  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();\n  const { digitalTwinMood, intimacyScore, moodHistory } = useStore();\n\n  const scoreLabels = useMemo(\n    () => [\"\", t(\"moodPanel.score1\"), t(\"moodPanel.score2\"), t(\"moodPanel.score3\"), t(\"moodPanel.score4\"), t(\"moodPanel.score5\")],\n    [t],\n  );\n\n  const moodText = t(`mood.${digitalTwinMood}`);\n  const moodEmoji: Record<DigitalTwinMood, string> = {\n    happy: \"😊\",\n    calm: \"😌\",\n    bored: \"😐\",\n    anxious: \"😟\",\n    sleepy: \"😴\",\n  };\n\n  const chartData = useMemo(() => {\n    if (moodHistory.length === 0) return [];\n    return moodHistory.map((r) => ({\n      time: new Date(r.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString(i18n.language, { hour: \"2-digit\", minute: \"2-digit\" }),\n      score: MOOD_SCORE[r.mood] ?? 3,\n      label: t(`mood.${r.mood}`),\n    }));\n  }, [moodHistory, t, i18n.language]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 space-y-3\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\">{t(\"moodPanel.title\")}</p>\n\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n          <span className=\"text-4xl\">{moodEmoji[digitalTwinMood]}</span>\n          <div>\n            <p className=\"font-semibold text-gray-800\">{moodText}</p>\n            <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">{t(\"moodPanel.currentMood\")}</p>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <ScoreRing\n          score={intimacyScore}\n          color=\"#ec4899\"\n          label={t(\"moodPanel.intimacy\")}\n          size={56}\n          strokeWidth={5}\n        />\n      </div>\n\n      {chartData.length > 2 && (\n        <div>\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1\">{t(\"moodPanel.moodChange\")}</p>\n          <ResponsiveContainer width=\"100%\" height={80}>\n            <LineChart data={chartData}>\n              <XAxis\n                dataKey=\"time\"\n                tick={{ fontSize: 10 }}\n                axisLine={false}\n                tickLine={false}\n                interval=\"preserveStartEnd\"\n              />\n              <YAxis domain={[0, 6]} hide />\n              <Tooltip\n                contentStyle={{ fontSize: 11, borderRadius: 8, border: \"1px solid #e5e7eb\" }}\n                // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any\n                formatter={((value: any) => {\n                  const v = typeof value === \"number\" ? value : 0;\n                  return [scoreLabels[v] || String(v), t(\"moodPanel.moodAxis\")];\n                }) as any}\n              />\n              <Line\n                type=\"monotone\"\n                dataKey=\"score\"\n                stroke=\"#a78bfa\"\n                strokeWidth={2}\n                dot={false}\n              />\n            </LineChart>\n          </ResponsiveContainer>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport { useTranslation } from \"react-i18next\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport ScoreRing from \"./ScoreRing\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\nimport { formatAwayDuration } from \"../i18n/helpers\";\n\nfunction computeActivityScore(events: PetEvent[]): number {\n  const todayEvents = events.filter(\n    (e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),\n  );\n  if (todayEvents.length === 0) return 0;\n  const base = Math.min(todayEvents.length * 8, 60);\n  const variety = new Set(todayEvents.map((e) => e.behavior_type)).size;\n  return Math.min(base + variety * 10, 100);\n}\n\nfunction activityLabel(t: (k: string, o?: { defaultValue?: string }) => string, key: string): string {\n  const k = `activity.${key}`;\n  const v = t(k);\n  return v === k ? t(\"activity.unknown\") : v;\n}\n\nexport default function SensorPanel() {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { events, currentActivity, bleConnected, awayDuration } = useStore();\n\n  const activityScore = useMemo(() => computeActivityScore(events), [events]);\n  const activityInfoLabel = activityLabel(t, currentActivity);\n  const todayCount = events.filter(\n    (e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),\n  ).length;\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\">{t(\"sensorPanel.title\")}</p>\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-4 gap-2\">\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center\">\n          <ScoreRing score={activityScore} color=\"#6366f1\" label={t(\"sensorPanel.activity\")} size={48} strokeWidth={4} />\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-2xl\">📊</span>\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1\">{activityInfoLabel}</p>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <span className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full mb-1 ${bleConnected ? \"bg-green-500\" : \"bg-gray-400\"}`} />\n          <p className=\"text-sm font-bold text-gray-800\">\n            {bleConnected ? t(\"sensorPanel.home\") : formatAwayDuration(awayDuration, t)}\n          </p>\n          <p className=\"text-[10px] text-gray-400\">{t(\"sensorPanel.away\")}</p>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <p className=\"text-xl font-bold text-gray-800\">{todayCount}</p>\n          <p className=\"text-[10px] text-gray-400\">{t(\"sensorPanel.eventsToday\")}</p>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport { useTranslation } from \"react-i18next\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { ACTIVITY_LABELS } from \"../types\";\n\nexport default function ActivityBar() {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { currentActivity, events } = useStore();\n  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);\n\n  const latestEvent = events[0];\n  const activityStart = latestEvent ? new Date(latestEvent.timestamp).getTime() : Date.now();\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const tick = () => setElapsed(Math.floor((Date.now() - activityStart) / 1000));\n    tick();\n    const timer = setInterval(tick, 1000);\n    return () => clearInterval(timer);\n  }, [activityStart]);\n\n  const formatDuration = (s: number) => {\n    if (s < 60) return t(\"duration.seconds\", { s });\n    if (s < 3600) return t(\"duration.minutes\", { m: Math.floor(s / 60) });\n    return t(\"duration.hours\", { h: Math.floor(s / 3600), m: Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60) });\n  };\n\n  const info = ACTIVITY_LABELS[currentActivity] ?? ACTIVITY_LABELS.unknown;\n  const label = useMemo(() => {\n    const k = `activity.${currentActivity}`;\n    const v = t(k);\n    return v === k ? t(\"activity.unknown\") : v;\n  }, [currentActivity, t]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between bg-white rounded-xl px-4 py-3 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n        <span className=\"text-lg\">{info.icon}</span>\n        <span className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\">{label}</span>\n      </div>\n      <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">{t(\"activityBar.elapsed\", { duration: formatDuration(elapsed) })}</span>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useNavigate } from \"react-router-dom\";\nimport { useTranslation } from \"react-i18next\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\n\nexport default function PetChatPreview() {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { chatMessages, bleConnected, pets, activePetId } = useStore();\n  const pet = pets.find((p) => p.id === activePetId);\n  const petName = pet?.name ?? t(\"common.petDefault\");\n  const lastMsg = chatMessages[chatMessages.length - 1];\n\n  return (\n    <div\n      role=\"button\"\n      tabIndex={0}\n      onClick={() => navigate(\"/pet-chat\")}\n      onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === \"Enter\" || e.key === \" \") navigate(\"/pet-chat\"); }}\n      className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-50 to-indigo-50 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-purple-100 cursor-pointer active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform\"\n    >\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-2\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n          <span className=\"text-lg\">💬</span>\n          <span className=\"text-sm font-medium text-purple-700\">{t(\"petChatPreview.title\", { name: petName })}</span>\n        </div>\n        <span className=\"text-xs text-purple-400\">\n          {bleConnected ? t(\"petChatPreview.collarOn\") : t(\"petChatPreview.collarOff\")}\n        </span>\n      </div>\n      <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 truncate\">\n        {lastMsg\n          ? `${lastMsg.role === \"pet\" ? `🐾 ${petName}` : t(\"petChatPreview.youPrefix\")}: ${lastMsg.content}`\n          : t(\"petChatPreview.previewStart\", { name: petName })}\n      </p>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\components\\ActivityTimeline.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useTranslation } from \"react-i18next\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\ninterface Props {\n  events: PetEvent[];\n}\n\ntype RiskLevel = \"rest\" | \"normal\" | \"attention\" | \"danger\";\n\nfunction riskLevel(behaviorType: string): RiskLevel {\n  if ([\"prolonged_still\"].includes(behaviorType)) return \"rest\";\n  if ([\"normal\"].includes(behaviorType)) return \"normal\";\n  if ([\"scratching\", \"head_shaking\", \"pacing\", \"barking\"].includes(behaviorType)) return \"attention\";\n  if ([\"foreign_eating\", \"panting\"].includes(behaviorType)) return \"danger\";\n  return \"normal\";\n}\n\nconst RISK_COLORS: Record<RiskLevel, string> = {\n  rest: \"#93C5FD\",\n  normal: \"#86EFAC\",\n  attention: \"#FDE047\",\n  danger: \"#FCA5A5\",\n};\n\nexport default function ActivityTimeline({ events }: Props) {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const now = new Date();\n  const todayStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()).getTime();\n  const totalMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;\n\n  const todayEvents = events\n    .filter((e) => new Date(e.timestamp).getTime() >= todayStart)\n    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.timestamp).getTime());\n\n  const segments = todayEvents.map((e) => {\n    const ts = new Date(e.timestamp).getTime();\n    const startPct = ((ts - todayStart) / totalMs) * 100;\n    const widthPct = Math.max((e.duration_ms / totalMs) * 100, 0.5);\n    return { startPct, widthPct, risk: riskLevel(e.behavior_type) };\n  });\n\n  const hours = [0, 6, 12, 18, 24];\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-3\">{t(\"activityTimeline.title\")}</p>\n      <div className=\"relative h-6 bg-gray-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden\">\n        {segments.map((seg, i) => (\n          <div\n            key={i}\n            className=\"absolute top-0 h-full rounded-full\"\n            style={{\n              left: `${seg.startPct}%`,\n              width: `${seg.widthPct}%`,\n              backgroundColor: RISK_COLORS[seg.risk],\n              minWidth: 3,\n            }}\n          />\n        ))}\n        <div\n          className=\"absolute top-0 h-full w-0.5 bg-indigo-500\"\n          style={{ left: `${((now.getTime() - todayStart) / totalMs) * 100}%` }}\n        />\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"flex justify-between mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-gray-400\">\n        {hours.map((h) => (\n          <span key={h}>{h}:00</span>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mt-2 text-[10px] text-gray-400 flex-wrap\">\n        <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n          <span className=\"w-2 h-2 rounded-full\" style={{ backgroundColor: RISK_COLORS.rest }} />\n          {t(\"activityTimeline.rest\")}\n        </span>\n        <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n          <span className=\"w-2 h-2 rounded-full\" style={{ backgroundColor: RISK_COLORS.normal }} />\n          {t(\"activityTimeline.normal\")}\n        </span>\n        <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n          <span className=\"w-2 h-2 rounded-full\" style={{ backgroundColor: RISK_COLORS.attention }} />\n          {t(\"activityTimeline.attention\")}\n        </span>\n        <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n          <span className=\"w-2 h-2 rounded-full\" style={{ backgroundColor: RISK_COLORS.danger }} />\n          {t(\"activityTimeline.danger\")}\n        </span>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}
```

 "contents": "import { useTranslation } from \"react-i18next\";\n\ninterface Props {\n  status: \"calm\" | \"attention\" | \"high_risk\";\n}\n\nexport default function StatusBadge({ status }: Props) {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const config: Record<string, { bg: string; labelKey: string }> = {\n    calm: { bg: \"bg-green-100 text-green-800\", labelKey: \"statusBadge.calm\" },\n    attention: { bg: \"bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800\", labelKey: \"statusBadge.attention\" },\n    high_risk: { bg: \"bg-red-100 text-red-800\", labelKey: \"statusBadge.high_risk\" },\n  };\n  const { bg, labelKey } = config[status] ?? config.calm;\n  return (\n    <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-medium ${bg}`}>\n      {t(labelKey)}\n    </span>\n  );\n}\n"
}

new Date(y, m, day).toLocaleDateString(locale, { month: \"short\", day: \"numeric\" })\n        : String(day);\n    points.push({ day, label, avg });\n    sum += avg;\n    rMin = Math.min(rMin, avg);\n    rMax = Math.max(rMax, avg);\n  }\n\n  const monthTitle = now.toLocaleDateString(locale, { month: \"long\", year: \"numeric\" });\n  const firstWeekAvg = points.slice(0, 7).reduce((a, p) => a + p.avg, 0) / Math.min(7, points.length);\n  const lastWeekAvg = points.slice(-7).reduce((a, p) => a + p.avg, 0) / Math.min(7, points.length);\n  const trendPercent = Math.round(((lastWeekAvg - firstWeekAvg) / Math.max(1, firstWeekAvg)) * 100);\n\n  return {\n    points,\n    monthTitle,\n    avg: Math.round(sum / daysInMonth),\n    rangeMin: rMin,\n    rangeMax: rMax,\n    trendPercent,\n  };\n}\n\n// ---- Body Temperature ----"

### 实现要点

1. **`mockHealthData.ts`**
   - `generateMockHeartRateWeek(locale)`：最近 7 天每天 `min` / `max`，自动高亮本周内的**周六**（或心率最高的一天），并生成日期范围文案。
   - `generateMockHeartRateMonth(locale)`：当月每日平均心率曲线、月标题、全月平均、波动区间、`trendPercent`（首尾周对比）。

2. **`HealthMetricDetail.tsx`（仅 `heart-rate`）**
   - 顶栏标题改为 `detailHeartRateHistory`（「心率历史」）。
   - 心率详情**不再使用**顶部大 Hero 卡片，改为与 Stitch 一致：**分段控件 → 日期/区间 + 大号平均 BPM +「平均」胶囊**。
   - **日**：24h `AreaChart`（原逻辑）+ 下方 **Average / Range** 两卡 + **Min / Avg / Max** 三格 + 日洞察文案。
   - **周**：自定义 **区间柱**（40–160 标尺、粉到主色渐变、高亮柱带光晕）+ **Average / Range** 两卡 + **Weekly insight** 黄卡（头像 + `auto_awesome`）。
   - **月**：`Monthly overview` 标题行 + **Range** 摘要 + 月度 **AreaChart** + **月平均 / 趋势%** 两色块 + **AI 健康报告** 卡片（与 `monthly/code.html` 信息层级一致）；月视图不再重复底部灰底 Average/Range，避免与上月度块重复。

3. **i18n**（zh / en / ja / ko）  
   新增如 `detailTabDay|Week|Month`、`detailHeartRateHistory`、`detailMonthlyOverview`、`detailWeeklyInsightBody` 等文案。

## 当前现状：两套固件并存，都是"桩代码"

你的 `firmware/` 目录下其实有 **两套并行的固件实现**：

| 路径 | 框架 | 入口函数 | 目标芯片 |
|------|------|---------|---------|
| `firmware/main/` | **ESP-IDF** 原生 | `app_main()` | ESP32-S3 |
| `firmware/src/` | **TuyaOpen SDK** | `tuya_app_main()` | T5AI-CORE |

它们各有自己的 CMakeLists.txt 和一整套同名模块（`ble_service`、`rule_engine`、`decision_engine` 等），但调用的 API 完全不同。

`firmware/main/main.c` 用的是 ESP-IDF 原生：

```24:34:d:\文档\Cursor\pet-collar\firmware\main\main.c

{

    esp_err_t ret = nvs_flash_init();

    imu_driver_init();
    audio_driver_init();
    ble_service_init();

}
```

`firmware/src/tuya_app_main.c` 用的是 TuyaOpen：

```20:38:d:\文档\Cursor\pet-collar\firmware\src\tuya_app_main.c

    audio_driver_init();

}

而且架构方案文档写的还是 ESP32-S3 / ESP-IDF：

```

**这说明当前固件还没有真正跑通过，只是两套框架的 stub/桩代码。**

## 如果要在 T5AI 上编译烧录

基于当前 `app_default.config` 的配置，理论上的流程是：

1. **搭建 TuyaOpen 环境**（运行 `export.sh` 激活）
2. **把 `firmware/` 作为一个 TuyaOpen 应用项目**，放到 `apps/` 目录下
3. **选板并构建**：
   ```bash
   cd apps/pet-collar-firmware
   tos.py config choice    # 选择 T5AI / TUYA_T5AI_CORE
   tos.py build
   ```
4. **烧录**：
   ```bash
   tos.py flash -p <串口>
   ```
5. **查看日志**：
   ```bash
   tos.py monitor -p <串口> -b 460800
   ```

**但实际上你现在跑不通**，因为：
- `firmware/src/` 里的驱动都是空壳（函数体基本是 `PR_DEBUG` + 返回），没有真正调用 TuyaOpen 的 `tkl_i2c_*`、`tkl_ble_*` 等底层 API
- 项目结构不完全符合 TuyaOpen 项目规范（缺少 Kconfig、完整的 config 目录等）
- 两套代码混在一起，CMakeLists.txt 的构建路径可能互相冲突

---

## 做成 SDK 是否更好？你的分析非常对

从你目前的项目来看，**做成一个分层 SDK 是明显更好的选择**。原因和建议如下：

### 为什么要做 SDK 分层

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  应用层 (Application)                            │
│  tuya_app_main.c / app_main()                   │
│  业务流程编排、初始化顺序                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  业务逻辑层 (Pet Collar SDK)     ← 你的核心 SDK  │
│  rule_engine / decision_engine / event_manager   │
│  intervention / audio_analysis                   │
│  纯 C，不依赖任何平台 API                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  硬件抽象层 (HAL)                                │
│  pet_collar_hal.h ← 统一接口定义                  │
│  ├── hal_tuyaopen.c  (调 tkl_* API → T5AI)      │
│  ├── hal_espidf.c    (调 esp_* API → ESP32-S3)  │
│  └── hal_mock.c      (桩实现 → PC 模拟器)        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  平台 SDK (TuyaOpen / ESP-IDF / Linux)           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 具体好处

| 好处 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **一套业务代码，多平台跑** | `rule_engine.c`、`decision_engine.c` 等核心逻辑只写一份，不需要 `main/` 和 `src/` 两套 |
| **PC 上可单元测试** | 用 `hal_mock.c` 喂假数据，验证算法逻辑不需要硬件 |
| **换芯片成本低** | 只需新增一个 `hal_xxx.c`，不动业务代码 |
| **团队协作** | 硬件工程师写 HAL，算法工程师写业务层，互不干扰 |
| **当前两套代码可以合一** | 消除 `firmware/main/` 和 `firmware/src/` 的重复 |

### 建议的目录结构

```
firmware/
├── pet_collar_sdk/              # 平台无关的核心 SDK
│   ├── include/
│   │   ├── pet_collar_hal.h     # HAL 接口定义 (i2c_read, gpio_set, ble_notify...)
│   │   ├── pet_collar_config.h  # 阈值/常量配置
│   │   ├── rule_engine.h
│   │   ├── decision_engine.h
│   │   ├── event_manager.h
│   │   └── intervention.h
│   └── src/
│       ├── rule_engine.c        # 纯逻辑，调 HAL 接口
│       ├── decision_engine.c
│       ├── event_manager.c
│       └── intervention.c
│
├── hal/                         # 各平台 HAL 实现
│   ├── tuyaopen/
│   │   ├── hal_tuyaopen.c       # tkl_i2c_*, tkl_ble_*, ...
│   │   └── CMakeLists.txt
│   ├── espidf/
│   │   ├── hal_espidf.c         # esp_i2c_*, nimble_*
│   │   └── CMakeLists.txt
│   └── mock/
│       └── hal_mock.c           # PC 模拟/单测
│
├── targets/
│   ├── tuyaopen_t5ai/           # TuyaOpen T5AI 项目壳
│   │   ├── tuya_app_main.c
│   │   ├── app_default.config
│   │   └── CMakeLists.txt
│   └── espidf_esp32s3/          # ESP-IDF 项目壳
│       ├── main.c
│       ├── sdkconfig.defaults
│       └── CMakeLists.txt
│
└── tests/                       # PC 端单元测试
    ├── test_rule_engine.c
    └── test_decision_engine.c
```

### `pet_collar_hal.h` 大致长这样

```c
#ifndef PET_COLLAR_HAL_H
#define PET_COLLAR_HAL_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

typedef int pc_err_t;
#define PC_OK      0
#define PC_ERR    -1

/* I2C */
pc_err_t pc_hal_i2c_init(uint8_t port, uint8_t scl, uint8_t sda, uint32_t freq_hz);
pc_err_t pc_hal_i2c_write_reg(uint8_t port, uint8_t addr, uint8_t reg, const uint8_t *data, uint16_t len);
pc_err_t pc_hal_i2c_read_reg(uint8_t port, uint8_t addr, uint8_t reg, uint8_t *data, uint16_t len);

/* GPIO */
pc_err_t pc_hal_gpio_init(uint8_t pin, bool output);
pc_err_t pc_hal_gpio_set(uint8_t pin, bool level);

/* PWM */
pc_err_t pc_hal_pwm_init(uint8_t pin, uint32_t freq_hz);
pc_err_t pc_hal_pwm_set_duty(uint8_t pin, uint8_t duty_percent);
pc_err_t pc_hal_pwm_stop(uint8_t pin);

/* BLE */
pc_err_t pc_hal_ble_init(const char *name);
pc_err_t pc_hal_ble_notify(uint16_t char_handle, const uint8_t *data, uint16_t len);

/* Timer / Sleep */
pc_err_t pc_hal_sleep_ms(uint32_t ms);
uint32_t pc_hal_tick_ms(void);

/* Log */
void pc_hal_log(const char *fmt, ...);

#endif
```

---

## 总结建议

1. **短期（先跑通）**：选定一个平台（推荐 T5AI + TuyaOpen，因为你的 config 已经指向它），把 `firmware/src/` 里的桩代码补上真正的 `tkl_*` API 调用，按 TuyaOpen 的项目规范组织目录，用 `tos.py build && tos.py flash` 先跑通一个 LED 闪烁或 I2C 读取。

2. **中期（SDK 化重构）**：按上面的分层结构提取 HAL 层，把 `rule_engine` / `decision_engine` 等业务逻辑与平台解耦。这样 `firmware/main/`（ESP-IDF）和 `firmware/src/`（TuyaOpen）就不再是两套独立代码，而是同一个 SDK + 不同 HAL 实现。

3. **长期**：SDK 化后可以加 PC 端单元测试、CI 自动构建多目标、甚至支持更多芯片平台。

如果你想开始实施（无论是先跑通 T5AI 还是做 SDK 分层），可以切换到 Agent 模式，我来帮你具体改代码。

把我们的自定义协议(EventReport / IMUSummary / AudioFeature / InterventionCmd)作为 **应用层数据包**, 通过 Tuya 的 Notify/Write 通道收发, 用每个包的第一字节 `packet_type` 区分:\n\n``​`\n[Collar -> App]  tal_ble_server_common_send(data)\n  packet_type=0x01 -> EventReport (23 bytes)\n  packet_type=0x02 -> IMUSummary (12 bytes)\n  packet_type=0x03 -> AudioFeature (8 bytes)\n  packet_type=0x04 -> BatteryLevel (1 byte)\n\n[App -> Collar]  TAL_BLE_EVT_WRITE_REQ callback\n  packet_type=0x10 -> InterventionCmd (6 bytes)\n  packet_type=0x11 -> AudioUpload (chunk)\n  packet_type=0x12 -> ConfigUpdate\n``​`\n\n> 前端 `ble.ts` 需同步修改: 从连接自定义 UUID 改为连接 Tuya BLE Service UUID 0xFD50。本次计划仅改固件侧。\n\n### 2. 音频: 使用 T5AI-CORE 板载模拟麦克风\n\n硬件文档确认 T5AI-CORE 自带 **板载模拟麦克风**, 通过 T5 模块内置 ADC 采集, 规格为 **16kHz / 16bit / 单声道**。BSP 通过 `tdd_audio_register()` + `TDD_AUDIO_T5AI_T` 配置。\n\n**方案**: \n- 在 `tuya_app_main.c` 中调用 `board_register_hardware()` 注册板级音频设备\n- 在 `audio_driver.c` 中通过 TuyaOpen 的音频输入 API (`tkl_ai_*`) 读取 PCM 数据\n- 在固件侧完成简单 DSP: 计算 RMS、过零率 (ZCR)、频谱质心\n- panting_score / chewing_score 用基于频率/节律的简单阈值规则估算\n\n### 3. 入口文件重构\n\n当前 `tuya_app_main.c` 缺少:\n- `tal_sw_timer_init()` / `tal_workq_init()` 等基础设施初始化\n- BLE 栈初始化 (`tal_ble_bt_init`)\n- 板级硬件注册 (`board_register_hardware`)\n\n需参照官方 `your_chat_bot` 示例补全。\n\n## 实施步骤\n\n### Step 1: 更新 `tuya_app_main.c` 入口\n\n参照 [TuyaOpen your_chat_bot/tuya_main.c](https://github.com/tuya/TuyaOpen/blob/master/apps/tuya.ai/your_chat_bot/src/tuya_main.c) 的初始化流程:\n\n- 添加 `tal_sw_timer_init()`, `tal_workq_init()` 调用\n- 调用 `board_register_hardware()` 注册板级音频/LED/按钮\n- 在各子系统 init 之后调用 `ble_service_init()` 启动 BLE 广播\n- 增加栈深度到 `1024 * 8`\n\n关键文件: [firmware/src/tuya_app_main.c](firmware/src/tuya_app_main.c)\n\n### Step 2: 补全 `ble_service.c` BLE 实现\n\n基于 [TuyaOpen ble_peripher 示例](https://github.com/tuya/TuyaOpen/blob/master/examples/ble/ble_peripher/src/example_ble_peripheral.c) 实现:\n\n- `ble_service_init()`: 调用 `tal_ble_bt_init(TAL_BLE_ROLE_PERIPERAL, event_cb)`, 在 `TAL_BLE_STACK_INIT` 事件中设置广播数据并启动广播\n- 广播数据: 包含设备名 \"PetCollar-XXXX\"\n- 事件回调处理: 连接/断开(管理连接状态)、`TAL_BLE_EVT_WRITE_REQ`(解析 App 下发的干预指令/音频上传/配置)、`TAL_BLE_EVT_SUBSCRIBE`(记录 notify 使能状态)、MTU 协商\n- `ble_send_event_report()` / `ble_send_imu_summary()` / `ble_send_audio_feature()`: 调用 `tal_ble_server_common_send()` 发送带 packet_type 前缀的数据包\n- 断线后自动重新广播\n\n关键文件: [firmware/src/ble_service.c](firmware/src/ble_service.c), [firmware/src/ble_service.h](firmware/src/ble_service.h)\n\n### Step 3: 补全 `audio_driver.c` 音频采集 + 特征提取\n\n- 通过 TuyaOpen 音频 API 从板载麦克风采集 16kHz/16bit PCM 数据\n- 实现 1 秒窗口的 DSP 特征计算:\n  - **RMS Energy**: `sqrt(sum(x^2)/N)`\n  - **Zero Crossing Rate (ZCR)**: 相邻样本符号变化次数 / N\n  - **Spectral Centroid**: 通过 256-point FFT 计算频谱质心 (需要简单的定点 FFT 实现或查表)\n  - **Panting Score**: 基于 2-5Hz 频段能量占比的简单估算\n  - **Chewing Score**: 基于 100-500Hz 频段的短时能量变化节律\n- 每秒通过回调输出一次 `audio_features_t`\n\n关键文件: [firmware/src/audio_driver.c](firmware/src/audio_driver.c)\n\n> 注: 音频特征提取中的 panting/chewing score 算法在 MVP 阶段使用简化的频域/时域规则,不引入完整 ML 推理。\n\n### Step 4: 更新配置和头文件\n\n- **`app_default.config`**: 添加 `CONFIG_ENABLE_AUDIO_CODECS=y`, `CONFIG_ENABLE_AUDIO_AEC=y` 等音频相关标志\n- **`pet_collar_config.h`**: 添加音频采样率/缓冲区大小常量, 确认 Speaker Enable Pin (P39)\n- **`CMakeLists.txt`**: 确保 `board_com_api.h` 和  "contents": "/**\n * Application-layer framing on top of TuyaOpen tal_ble \"common\" write/notify channel.\n * First byte identifies payload type; remaining bytes match ble_gatt_profile structs where applicable.\n */\n#ifndef PET_COLLAR_BLE_PROTO_H\n#define PET_COLLAR_BLE_PROTO_H\n\n#include <stdint.h>\n\n/* Collar -> central (notify) */\n#define PC_BLE_PKT_EVENT_REPORT    0x01u /* event_report_t, 23 bytes */\n#define PC_BLE_PKT_IMU_SUMMARY     0x02u /* imu_summary_t, 12 bytes */\n#define PC_BLE_PKT_AUDIO_FEATURE   0x03u /* audio_feature_t, 8 bytes */\n#define PC_BLE_PKT_BATTERY         0x04u /* 1 byte level 0-100 */\n\n/* Central -> collar (write) */\n#define PC_BLE_PKT_INTERVENTION_CMD 0x10u /* intervention_cmd_t, 6 bytes */\n#define PC_BLE_PKT_AUDIO_UPLOAD     0x11u /* variable chunk */\n#define PC_BLE_PKT_CONFIG_UPDATE    0x12u /* variable, MVP: log only */\n\n#define PC_BLE_MAX_NOTIFY_PAYLOAD   48u\n\n#endif /* PET_COLLAR_BLE_PROTO_H */\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\src\\ble_service.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * BLE transport for T5AI-CORE using TuyaOpen tal_ble peripheral + built-in GATT profile.\n * Application framing: see pet_collar_ble_proto.h (payload types on common write/notify characteristics).\n */\n\n#include \"ble_service.h\"\n#include \"pet_collar_ble_proto.h\"\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"tuya_cloud_types.h\"\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n#include \"tal_bluetooth.h\"\n#include \"tal_bluetooth_def.h\"\n\n#include <string.h>\n\n#define TAG \"ble_svc\"\n\n/* Advertising / scan response — follow TuyaOpen ble_peripher example for stack compatibility */\nstatic uint8_t adv_data_const[31] = {\n    0x02, 0x01, 0x06, 0x03, 0x02, 0xFD, 0xFD, 0x17, 0x16, 0x50, 0xFD, 0x41, 0x00,\n    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,\n};\n\nstatic uint8_t scan_rsp_data_const[31] = {\n    0x17, 0xFF, 0xD0, 0x07, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,\n    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x03, 0x09, 0x50, 0x43, /* \"PC\" short name hint after Tuya block */\n    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,\n};\n\nstatic TAL_BLE_PEER_INFO_T sg_peer;\nstatic bool sg_connected = false;\nstatic bool sg_notify_enabled = false;\nstatic bool sg_stack_inited = false;\n\nstatic void ble_restart_advertising(void)\n{\n    TAL_BLE_DATA_T adv_data;\n    TAL_BLE_DATA_T rsp_data;\n\n    adv_data.p_data = adv_data_const;\n    adv_data.len = sizeof(adv_data_const);\n    rsp_data.p_data = scan_rsp_data_const;\n    rsp_data.len = sizeof(scan_rsp_data_const);\n\n    tal_ble_advertising_data_set(&adv_data, &rsp_data);\n    tal_ble_advertising_start(TUYAOS_BLE_DEFAULT_ADV_PARAM);\n}\n\nstatic void ble_handle_write(const uint8_t *data, uint16_t len)\n{\n    if (data == NULL || len < 1) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    switch (data[0]) {\n    case PC_BLE_PKT_INTERVENTION_CMD: {\n        if (len < 1u + sizeof(intervention_cmd_t)) {\n            PR_WARN(\"%s: intervention cmd too short: %u\", TAG, len);\n            return;\n        }\n        const intervention_cmd_t *cmd = (const intervention_cmd_t *)(data + 1);\n        intervention_execute((intervention_cmd_type_t)cmd->cmd_type,\n                             (intervention_level_t)cmd->level,\n                             cmd->audio_slot_id);\n        break;\n    }\n    case PC_BLE_PKT_AUDIO_UPLOAD:\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: audio upload chunk len=%u (MVP: not stored)\", TAG, len);\n        break;\n    case PC_BLE_PKT_CONFIG_UPDATE:\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: config update len=%u (MVP: ignored)\", TAG, len);\n        break;\n    default:\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: unknown write pkt 0x%02X len=%u\", TAG, data[0], len);\n        break;\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void ble_event_cb(TAL_BLE_EVT_PARAMS_T *p_event)\n{\n    if (p_event == NULL) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    switch (p_event->type) {\n    case TAL_BLE_STACK_INIT:\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: BLE stack init, result=%u\", TAG, p_event->ble_event.init);\n        if (p_event->ble_event.init == 0) {\n            sg_stack_inited = true;\n            tal_system_sleep(200);\n            ble_restart_advertising();\n        }\n        break;\n\n    case TAL_BLE_EVT_PERIPHERAL_CONNECT:\n        if (p_event->ble_event.connect.result == 0) {\n            memcpy(&sg_peer, &p_event->ble_event.connect.peer, sizeof(TAL_BLE_PEER_INFO_T));\n            sg_connected = true;\n            PR_DEBUG(\"%s: connected\", TAG);\n\n            /* Allow host to read combined adv+rsp (matches Tuya example) */\n            TAL_BLE_DATA_T read_data;\n            uint8_t read_buffer[sizeof(adv_data_const) + sizeof(scan_rsp_data_const)];\n            memcpy(read_buffer, adv_data_const, sizeof(adv_data_const));\n            memcpy(read_buffer + sizeof(adv_data_const), scan_rsp_data_const, sizeof(scan_rsp_data_const));\n            read_data.p_data = read_buffer;\n            read_data.len = sizeof(adv_data_const) + sizeof(scan_rsp_data_const);\n            tal_ble_server_common_read_update(&read_data);\n        } else {\n            memset(&sg_peer, 0, sizeof(sg_peer));\n            sg_connected = false;\n        }\n        break;\n\n    case TAL_BLE_EVT_DISCONNECT:\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: disconnected reason=%u\", TAG, p_event->ble_event.disconnect.reason);\n        memset(&sg_peer, 0, sizeof(sg_peer));\n        sg_connected = false;\n        sg_notify_enabled = false;\n        ble_restart_advertising();\n        break;\n\n    case TAL_BLE_EVT_CONN_PARAM_UPDATE:\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: conn param update\", TAG);\n        break;\n\n    case TAL_BLE_EVT_MTU_REQUEST:\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: MTU req, respond with 247\", TAG);\n        tal_ble_server_exchange_mtu_reply(sg_peer, 247);\n        break;\n\n    case TAL_BLE_EVT_SUBSCRIBE: {\n        bool notify_now = (p_event->ble_event.subscribe.cur_notify != 0);\n        sg_notify_enabled = notify_now;\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: subscribe notify:%u->%u\", TAG,\n                 (unsigned)p_event->ble_event.subscribe.prev_notify,\n                 (unsigned)p_event->ble_event.subscribe.cur_notify);\n        break;\n    }\n\n    case TAL_BLE_EVT_WRITE_REQ:\n        ble_handle_write(p_event->ble_event.write_report.report.p_data,\n                         p_event->ble_event.write_report.report.len);\n        break;\n\n    default:\n        break;\n    }\n}\n\nstatic int ble_send_raw(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t len)\n{\n    if (!sg_stack_inited || !sg_connected || !sg_notify_enabled) {\n        return OPRT_COM_ERROR;\n    }\n    if (len == 0u || len > PC_BLE_MAX_NOTIFY_PAYLOAD) {\n        return OPRT_INVALID_PARM;\n    }\n\n    TAL_BLE_DATA_T pkt = { .len = len, .p_data = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)payload };\n    /* SDK takes non-const pointer; buffer must remain valid for synchronous send */\n    return tal_ble_server_common_send(&pkt);\n}\n\nint ble_service_init(void)\n{\n    OPERATE_RET ret = tal_ble_bt_init(TAL_BLE_ROLE_PERIPERAL, ble_event_cb);\n    if (ret != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: tal_ble_bt_init failed: %d\", TAG, ret);\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: BLE peripheral init OK (Tuya common GATT + app framing)\", TAG);\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n\nint ble_send_event_report(const event_report_t *report)\n{\n    if (report == NULL) {\n        return OPRT_INVALID_PARM;\n    }\n\n    uint8_t buf[sizeof(event_report_t)];\n    memcpy(buf, report, sizeof(buf));\n\n    int r = ble_send_raw(buf, sizeof(buf));\n    if (r != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: event_report notify skipped (no link or CCCD)\", TAG);\n    }\n    return r;\n}\n\nint ble_send_imu_summary(const imu_summary_t *summary)\n{\n    if (summary == NULL) {\n        return OPRT_INVALID_PARM;\n    }\n\n    uint8_t buf[1u + sizeof(imu_summary_t)];\n    buf[0] = PC_BLE_PKT_IMU_SUMMARY;\n    memcpy(buf + 1, summary, sizeof(*summary));\n    return ble_send_raw(buf, sizeof(buf));\n}\n\nint ble_send_audio_feature(const audio_feature_t *feature)\n{\n    if (feature == NULL) {\n        return OPRT_INVALID_PARM;\n    }\n\n    uint8_t buf[1u + sizeof(audio_feature_t)];\n    buf[0] = PC_BLE_PKT_AUDIO_FEATURE;\n    memcpy(buf + 1, feature, sizeof(*feature));\n    return ble_send_raw(buf, sizeof(buf));\n}\n\nint ble_update_battery_level(uint8_t level)\n{\n    uint8_t buf[2] = { PC_BLE_PKT_BATTERY, level };\n    return ble_send_raw(buf, sizeof(buf));\n}\n"
}

i < bits; i++) {\n        r = (r << 1) | (x & 1u);\n        x >>= 1;\n    }\n    return r;\n}\n\nvoid pet_fft_radix2_f(float *re, float *im, unsigned n)\n{\n    if (n < 2u || (n & (n - 1u)) != 0u) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    unsigned bits = 0;\n    for (unsigned t = n; t > 1u; t >>= 1) {\n        bits++;\n    }\n\n    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n        unsigned j = pet_reverse_bits(i, bits);\n        if (j > i) {\n            float tr = re[i];\n            float ti = im[i];\n            re[i] = re[j];\n            im[i] = im[j];\n            re[j] = tr;\n            im[j] = ti;\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (unsigned s = 1u; s <= bits; s++) {\n        unsigned m = 1u << s;\n        unsigned m2 = m >> 1;\n        float wmre = cosf(-2.0f * (float)M_PI / (float)m);\n        float wmim = sinf(-2.0f * (float)M_PI / (float)m);\n        for (unsigned k = 0; k < n; k += m) {\n            float wre = 1.0f;\n            float wim = 0.0f;\n            for (unsigned j = 0; j < m2; j++) {\n                unsigned idx = k + j + m2;\n                float tre = wre * re[idx] - wim * im[idx];\n                float tim = wre * im[idx] + wim * re[idx];\n                float ure = re[k + j];\n                float uim = im[k + j];\n                re[idx] = ure - tre;\n                im[idx] = uim - tim;\n                re[k + j] = ure + tre;\n                im[k + j] = uim + tim;\n                float nre = wre * wmre - wim * wmim;\n                float nim = wre * wmim + wim * wmre;\n                wre = nre;\n                wim = nim;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfloat pet_goertzel_mag_i16(const int16_t *x, uint32_t n, float sample_hz, float freq_hz)\n{\n    if (x == NULL || n < 8u || sample_hz <= 0.0f || freq_hz <= 0.0f) {\n        return 0.0f;\n    }\n\n    float k = (0.5f + (float)((int)((0.5f * (2.0f * (float)M_PI * freq_hz * (float)n / sample_hz) / (float)M_PI + 0.5f))));\n    if (k < 1.0f) {\n        k = 1.0f;\n    }\n    if (k > (float)n / 2.0f - 1.0f) {\n        k = (float)n / 2.0f - 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    float w = (2.0f * (float)M_PI * k) / (float)n;\n    float cosine = cosf(w);\n    float sine = sinf(w);\n    float coeff = 2.0f * cosine;\n\n    float s_prev = 0.0f;\n    float s_prev2 = 0.0f;\n\n    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n        float s = (float)x[i] + coeff * s_prev - s_prev2;\n        s_prev2 = s_prev;\n        s_prev = s;\n    }\n\n    float real = s_prev - s_prev2 * cosine;\n    float imag = s_prev2 * sine;\n    return sqrtf(real * real + imag * imag) / (float)n;\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "#include \"pet_dsp.h\"\n#include <math.h>\n\n#ifndef M_PI\n#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846\n#endif\n\nfloat pet_spectral_centroid_dft(const int16_t *x, uint32_t n, float sample_hz)\n{\n    if (x == NULL || n < 32u || sample_hz <= 0.0f) {\n        return 0.0f;\n    }\n\n    int kmax = (int)(n / 2u);\n    if (kmax > 128) {\n        kmax = 128;\n    }\n\n    float sum_mag = 0.0f;\n    float sum_fmag = 0.0f;\n\n    for (int k = 1; k < kmax; k++) {\n        float re = 0.0f;\n        float im = 0.0f;\n        float fk = (float)k;\n        float fn = (float)n;\n        for (uint32_t t = 0; t < n; t++) {\n            float ang = -2.0f * (float)M_PI * fk * (float)t / fn;\n            float v = (float)x[t];\n            re += v * cosf(ang);\n            im += v * sinf(ang);\n        }\n        float mag = sqrtf(re * re + im * im);\n        float fhz = fk * sample_hz / fn;\n        sum_mag += mag;\n        sum_fmag += fhz * mag;\n    }\n\n    return sum_mag > 1e-3f ? sum_fmag / sum_mag : 0.0f;\n}\n\nfloat pet_goertzel_mag_i16(const int16_t *x, uint32_t n, float sample_hz, float freq_hz)\n{\n    if (x == NULL || n < 8u || sample_hz <= 0.0f || freq_hz <= 0.0f) {\n        return 0.0f;\n    }\n\n    float kf = (freq_hz * (float)n) / sample_hz;\n    int k = (int)(0.5f + kf);\n    if (k < 1) {\n        k = 1;\n    }\n    if ((uint32_t)k >= n / 2u) {\n        k = (int)(n / 2u) - 1;\n    }\n    if (k < 1) {\n        return 0.0f;\n    }\n\n    float omega = (2.0f * (float)M_PI * (float)k) / (float)n;\n    float coeff = 2.0f * cosf(omega);\n    float s0 = 0.0f;\n    float s1 = 0.0f;\n    float s2 = 0.0f;\n\n    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n        s0 = (float)x[i] + coeff * s1 - s2;\n        s2 = s1;\n        s1 = s0;\n    }\n\n    float real = s1 - s2 * cosf(omega);\n    float imag = s2 * sinf(omega);\n    return sqrtf(real * real + imag * imag) / (float)n;\n}\n"

 "contents": "# Pet Collar 固件 (TuyaOpen / T5AI-CORE)\n\n本目录为 TuyaOpen 应用源码，需在已安装 [TuyaOpen SDK](https://github.com/tuya/TuyaOpen) 的环境中使用 `tos.py` 构建。\n\n## 构建步骤（概要）\n\n1. 克隆 TuyaOpen，执行 `export.sh`（或按官方文档）激活环境。\n2. 将本应用作为 `apps/` 下的工程，或按官方模板把 `src/`、`include/`、`app_default.config` 并入现有 TuyaOpen 应用目录。\n3. `tos.py config choice` 选择 **T5AI** / **TUYA_T5AI_CORE**。\n4. `tos.py build`，再 `tos.py flash -p <串口>` 烧录。\n\n## 依赖说明\n\n- `board_com_api.h`、`tdl_audio_manage.h`、`tal_bluetooth.h` 等头文件由 TuyaOpen SDK 提供。\n- `CONFIG_ENABLE_AUDIO_CODECS=y` 会由 Kconfig 生成 `AUDIO_CODEC_NAME` 等宏，供 `audio_driver.c` 调用 `tdl_audio_find()`。\n\n## BLE 协议\n\n应用层数据走 Tuya 内置 GATT 的 **Write / Notify** 特征；帧格式见 `include/pet_collar_ble_proto.h`。连接后需客户端写 CCCD 使能 Notify，固件才会通过 `tal_ble_server_common_send` 上报。\n"
}
